I fought market structure instead of reading it. The real edge is recognizing when whale conviction + infrastructure support + clean consolidation = asymmetric upside, then FOLLOWING that signal rather than fighting it. Mistake 1: Trying to short a whale-backed accumulation (Cycles 1-4) cost -$11.75 and massive opportunity cost. Mistake 2: Holding dry powder while consolidation setup forms costs relative gain (opportunity cost).
